messages:
alex kim: Quick poll — need to lock the release slot for v2.3 next Tue 10am PT. Can folks confirm availability? I also pasted a one-line agenda and a short prep checklist. /cc @maya rao @peter cho
maya rao: I'm OOO Tue morning, can't make 10am. I can do 2pm PT or Wed.
peter cho: 2pm works for me. Also does codefreeze happen EOD Mon? we need final RC by then.
jessica lopez: 2pm is good. I'll own the canary smoke plan.
ryan thompson: +1 for 2pm. Can we add an item for DB migration rollback plan? Last release hit that.
alex kim: Updated — new proposed slot Tue 2pm PT. Agenda: 1) Quick go/no-go checklist, 2) Rollout plan & canary owners, 3) DB migration + rollback, 4) Post-release monitoring and SLO checks. Prep checklist: - tag RC (sha) - run smoke locally - confirm capacity on dedicated pool - notify SRE. Example snippet: ```release_checklist: ["tag_rc", "run_smoke", "verify_capacity", "post_notice"]```
maya rao: tagging question — who should push the RC? I can if someone gives final thumbs.
peter cho: I'll cut the RC after final CI green. ping me when last PR merges.
jessica lopez: Can we get stakeholders to RSVP? Suggest sending a calendar invite with RSVP and a short form: yes/no/backup.
alex kim: I'll send invite. Quick RSVP list: @maya rao, @peter cho, @jessica lopez, @ryan thompson, @sophie ng (product), @devops-bot. Sophie pls confirm product sign-off availability.
sophie ng: I can make 2pm for the sign-off slot. Will prep a short go/no-go criteria doc.
devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Please attach runbook to the calendar event or visit https://redwood-internal/rel/runbooks/v2.3
maya rao: thanks. FYI, I have a migration dry-run Monday 11am PT, so cutting RC EOD Mon still ok.
alex kim: Great—locking Tue 2pm PT. Last asks before I send invite: owners for smoke: @jessica lopez, canary watchers: @ryan thompson, SRE liaison: @peter cho, Backup owner: @maya rao. Any objections? :thumbsup:
ryan thompson: :thumbsup:
jessica lopez: :thumbsup: I'll put the smoke checklist in the event.
peter cho: :thumbsup:
sophie ng: :thumbsup:
alex kim: I'll send calendar + short RSVP form in 10m. Thanks all!
